description: Search Pierre-Jean Tribot's entity base of 20th–21st century architecture and cultural institutions in the Baltic states and Finland (Tallinn, Riga, Vilnius, Helsinki, Tartu, Kaunas, Tampere, Pärnu, Klaipėda, Liepāja, Jūrmala, Narva): 215 buildings (incl. places outside the cities: Paimio, Hvitträsk, Dipoli, Serlachius, Villa Mairea, Muuratsalo…), a collection of architects' own houses and villas, 215 architects and engineers, 5 artists, 13 practices, 48 cultural institutions (museums, theatre and opera companies, orchestras, libraries) linked to the buildings they occupy, identities verified against Wikidata. Matches names (local, English, French), architects, styles, periods and descriptions; optional filters. Returns ids for get_architecture_record. / Cherche dans le socle d'entités architecture (pays baltes + Finlande).

city.description: Optional city filter, e.g. Riga, Kaunas

era.description: Optional cross-city era filter: before 1918 (Art Nouveau, National Romanticism), 1918–1944 (interwar), 1945–1990 (post-war / Soviet period), since 1991 (contemporary). Use this to compare cities; layers ('Layer n') are numbered per city.

kind.description: Entity kind: lieu = building, inst = cultural institution (museum, theatre company, orchestra, library) housed in a building, person/org = architects, route = editorial route by the author (default: all)

q.description: Free text: building, architect, style, theme (any language). Can be empty if filters are set.

theme.description: Optional collection filter: maison-architecte = houses architects built for themselves (e.g. Villa Aalto, Muuratsalo, Wivi Lönn), villa = architect-designed villas (e.g. Villa Mairea, Ainola).

type.description: Optional Schema.org type filter, e.g. Museum, Church, Library

name: search_baltic_finnish_architecture
